name: Pompom Pretty Parfait Okosamayou
original_name: ポムポムプリてぃパフぇ お子様用
source:
Hero is a college student. Before summer vacation he receives an e-mail from his father asking to manage one of the stores for two months. The store is actually a cafe with cute cosplay girls as waitresses. Will he succeed?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-january-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名大学生。暑假前，他收到父亲的邮件，请他帮忙经营一家店铺两个月。那家店其实是一间由可爱Cosplay女孩担任女服务员的咖啡馆。他能成功吗？

（来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-january-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]）
